From 02-07-1426, add 278 days:

278 − 29 = 249 days left.  
August (31), September (30), October (31), November (30), December (31) = 153 days total.  
249 − 153 = 96 days left into next year (1427).  
1427 is common year → January 31, February 28 = 59 days.  
96 − 59 = 37 days left → into March: 37 days → March 31 → April 6.
